Benchmarking against eleven existing models, and seven scRNA-seq datasets from BEELINE, including diverse cell types, species, and ground-truth networks (ChIP-seq, STRING, LOF/GOF), demonstrates that our proposed GeneKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both AUROC and AUPRC. Ablation studies of the proposed model confirm the necessity of each component. Biological validation on human hepatocyte and lung cancer datasets reveals that GeneKAN not only recovers known regulatory interactions with high precision but also identifies functionally relevant hub genes and oncogenic pathways. GeneKAN thus offers a powerful, interpretable, and scalable solution for GRN reconstruction under real-world conditions of data sparsity and noise, with significant potential for advancing systems biology and precision medicine.

summary.takeaway: 提出GeneKAN框架，结合多尺度图卷积与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）从单细胞RNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络，在多个基准上达到先进性能。
summary.methods: 采用基于核的图卷积模块分层编码基因表示，利用KANs通过可学习样条激活建模高阶可解释的TF-靶标关系；在BEELINE的七个scRNA-seq数据集上对比十一个现有模型，并进行消融实验和生物学验证。
summary.relevance: 直接对应GRN/Regulon主题，提供了一种新的GRN推断深度学习方法，并在多种细胞类型和物种上验证。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能数值或计算复杂度分析；生物学验证限于肝细胞和肺癌数据集，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: A Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Pathology Foundation Model for Molecular Decoding of H&E Images
papers.abstract: The microscopic structure of human tissues encodes molecular information that is not directly accessible by visual inspection. Current pathology foundation models improve histological interpretation but operate at multicellular resolution. It remains unclear whether routine histology contains structured molecular and cellular information recoverable at single-cell resolution, which biological properties are associated with this recoverability, and where its limits lie. Here, we introduce Loki2, a single-cell pathology foundation model trained on UniSeg, a pan-tissue resource integrating 15 million cells with segmentation, lineage annotations and measured or histology-inferred transcriptomic profiles. We examine the above question across cellular representation, molecular recoverability, and patient-level relevance. Loki2 captures cellular identity and continuous morphological variation, with interpretable latent dimensions linked to physical nuclear phenotypes through DAPI validation. Transcriptomic retrieval and in silico protein staining test molecular recoverability, with gene-level analyses revealing the strongest recovery for genes associated with morphologically distinct cellular identities and functions. Then, patient staging and biomarker discovery connect cellular morphology representations to clinical relevance. Together, these findings establish Loki2 as a biologically interpretable single-cell pathology foundation model and provide the opportunities of recovering cellular and molecular information from routine H&E histology at single-cell resolution.

summary.takeaway: 提出单细胞病理基础模型Loki2，基于UniSeg资源训练，探索从常规H&E图像在单细胞分辨率恢复分子和细胞信息的可能性。
summary.methods: 在整合1500万细胞、分割、谱系注释及测量或组织学推断转录组谱的泛组织资源UniSeg上训练；通过DAPI验证潜在维度与物理核表型的关联，用转录组检索和计算机模拟蛋白染色测试分子可恢复性。
summary.relevance: 与预训练主题相关，展示了病理基础模型在单细胞水平上的生物学可解释性和分子解码潜力。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体恢复性能指标或临床验证结果；分子可恢复性的限制和适用范围需进一步量化。

papers.title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations identify the contribution of reliability weighting. The results indicate that accounting for uncertain constituent effects improves generalization to unseen genetic and chemical combinations, with a moderate increase in training cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出ReliFlow，一种可靠性校准的残差传输条件流匹配模型，用于组合单细胞扰动预测，通过估计单基因效应的可靠性来校准加性源分布，提升对未见组合的泛化。
summary.methods: 使用仅训练集交叉拟合估计单基因效应可靠性，将速度分解为加性参考的已知校正和学习到的残差传输场；在Norman遗传扰动和ComboSciPlex药物组合数据上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动主题，提供了一种处理组合扰动预测中不确定性的新方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了MAE和相关性提升，但训练成本有中等增加；方法在更广泛扰动类型和数据集上的泛化性未充分展示。

papers.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.

summary.takeaway: 提出Hypnos双阶段边缘持续学习平台，模仿大脑觉醒-睡眠周期，在低功耗边缘设备上实现高效持续学习。
summary.methods: 觉醒阶段使用RISC-V MCU进行高效推理和轻量无梯度原型更新；睡眠阶段利用智能充电器进行基于 rehearsal 的梯度更新巩固；在ZCU104 FPGA上实现并采用28nm工艺合成，在CORe50 NICv2-391协议上基准测试。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，展示了边缘设备上持续学习的系统级实现和能效优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了准确率、延迟和计算节省，但未讨论在更复杂任务或动态环境下的可扩展性。

papers.title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

summary.takeaway: 提出Learning with Unlearning（LwU）统一框架，在突触层面划分权重以同时处理持续学习和机器遗忘，避免两者目标冲突。
summary.methods: 对每个权重基于保留数据和删除数据分别评分，将网络划分为四个区域并应用不同更新规则：仅保留权重冻结，仅删除权重清除并释放容量，争议权重采用正交于保留梯度的梯度上升步，剩余容量通过特权教师自蒸馏学习新任务。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，创新性地将持续学习与机器遗忘结合，解决同一系统中的目标冲突。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能数值或与基线的详细比较；在真实世界数据集（PAI）上的实用性需进一步验证。

papers.title: UCLIR: Unsupervised Continual Learning using Independent Representations
papers.abstract: In continual learning, regularization-based methods aim to mimic neuroplasticity by updating network weights to learn new tasks while constraining changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks through penalty terms. However, as the number of tasks increases, preserving knowledge from earlier tasks becomes less effective. This is mainly because updates for new tasks are distributed across the entire network, where parameters are highly interdependent due to the dense connectivity between neurons. Inspired by the Exponential Distance Rule (EDR), which states that the number of neural connections decreases with increasing physical distance, learning is naturally locally correlated while inter-area updates remain less task-dependent. Motivated by this principle, in this paper we demonstrate that applying weight regularization to multiple small and independently learned complementary representations is more effective than regularizing a single large shared representation. By decomposing the input into independently learned components, learning new tasks induces only localized parameter updates within specific representation, which limit interference and improve knowledge retention across tasks. We employ independent autoencoders that learn different parts of the input independently through unsupervised regularization. At inference time, a linear classifier is used for evaluation. The experimental results on a sequence of tasks using 5-Splits MNIST, sequence of 5-datasets, 5-Splits CIFAR-10, 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet shows competitive results with supervised and replay-based methods. Code is available.

summary.takeaway: 提出UCLIR无监督持续学习方法，通过独立自编码器学习互补表示并对多个小表示进行权重正则化，以限制新任务学习时的参数干扰。
summary.methods: 受指数距离规则启发，将输入分解为独立学习的成分，使用独立自编码器通过无监督正则化学习不同部分，推理时使用线性分类器；在5-Splits MNIST、5-datasets序列、5-Splits CIFAR-10和10-Splits Tiny ImageNet上评估。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，提供了一种基于独立表示的无监督持续学习方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称取得竞争性结果，未提供具体数值；方法在更复杂或真实世界任务上的有效性未充分展示。

papers.title: Beyond Partial Readouts: Toward Integrative Mechanism Inference in Catalytic Oxidation.
papers.abstract: Oxidative reactive species (ORSs) provide a shared mechanism language for catalytic oxidation in both natural systems and industrial applications. Mechanism investigation seeks to explain how these processes proceed and how they can be regulated, conventionally focusing on identifying the dominant ORS and quantifying its contribution to substrate transformation. Yet ORSs are short-lived, present at low concentrations, and are rapidly interconverting, making their mechanism roles inseparable from the complex environment in which they form, transform, and decay. Disagreements among established identification methods have consequently become a recurring source of controversy across well-studied oxidation systems. Typically, ORS participations are examined through chemical probing, quenching, or direct spectroscopic detection. The widely used chemical approaches assume that each reagent reacts selectively with a single target species, allowing an experimental response to be read as a mechanism assignment. Such selectivity is scarcely attainable where multiple reactive species coexist and interconvert, so refining reagents or instruments alone cannot reconstruct the underlying chemistry once each response is assigned to one species. Our previous work on spin-trapping electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) exposed this vulnerability, revealing that even this widely trusted probe can enter the reaction chemistry. Reconstructing these signals into kinetic profiles successfully resolved when each reporting product forms, evolves, and decays, although temporal resolution alone cannot trace the reactions linking these stages. To organize this chemistry, we cast catalytic oxidation as a directed reactive species network, mapping each reactive species onto a node and every route of generation, interconversion, transformation, and dissipation onto an edge. External substrates or reporters couple to these nodes through distinct reactions weighted by their rate constants. Therefore, ORS dominance is not an intrinsic property of any node but a condition-dependent property of the network, set by how reaction conditions distribute reactive flux and by the substrate or reporter through which the network is read. Whether through probing, quenching, or direct detection, each measurement returns a low-dimensional projection of this high-dimensional network, so conflicting assignments may reflect one dynamic mechanism rather than incompatible chemistries. Recovering the hidden organization behind these partial projections thus becomes an inverse problem. In this Account, we revisit current ORS identification strategies, examine how chemical, kinetic, and spectroscopic evidence constrains mechanism interpretation, and present a network basis for reconstructing the hidden chemistry behind the resulting observations. Realizing this route appeals to AI-assisted inference under chemist-centered judgment and to structured databases built under this network view through automated experiments, literature mining, and modeling orchestrated by agentic workflows. Thus, it offers not only a reinterpretation of the mechanism puzzles accumulated over decades but a new point of departure for the work ahead.

papers.title: Integrative spatial metallomics: a tutorial review of multimodal elemental imaging workflows, challenges and opportunities.
papers.abstract: Spatially resolved molecular assays are increasingly used to study human health and disease, revealing complex tissue organization beyond what is accessible through bulk analyses. While spatial transcriptomic, metabolomic, and proteomic approaches have rapidly matured, quantitative mapping of metals and trace elements in biological tissues and biominerals through elemental imaging remains comparatively nascent. Elemental distributions alone often provide limited biological interpretation without contextualization within the tissue microenvironment. Here, we summarize themes and computational strategies for integrating spatial elemental data with histopathology and complementary spatial molecular assays. We highlight multimodal approaches for tissue alignment, pixel-wise clustering, and correlative analysis, illustrated through limited use cases involving amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and kidney stone formation. In the ALS cohort, pixel-level elemental profiles were clustered and compared with annotated tissue structures. In the kidney stone cohort, spatial gradients and correlations in elemental and biomolecular features from the renal papilla through the medulla to cortex were examined. Finally, we discuss key challenges for cross-sample, cohort-level analyses, including differences in spatial resolution, normalization, tissue architecture, and mechanistic inference. Addressing these challenges will require interdisciplinary collaboration, enhanced biobanking practices, and development of computational and statistical frameworks.

summary.takeaway: 本教程综述总结了将空间元素成像数据与组织病理学及其他空间分子检测进行整合的计算策略，强调多模态配准、像素级聚类和相关分析，并以ALS与肾结石为示例用例。
summary.methods: 综述性教程，归纳组织对齐、像素级聚类与相关分析等多模态整合策略，并简要展示ALS队列中的像素级元素谱聚类与组织注释比较、肾结石队列中从肾乳头到皮质区域的空间梯度与元素-生物分子相关分析。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及机制推理主题：讨论如何从空间元素分布结合组织微环境与互补分子数据推断生物学意义，并指出跨样本、队列级分析中空间分辨率、归一化与机制推断等挑战。
